notes: Printed Rabid Bite: 'Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature you don't control.' Cast from the act menu as a dealt game casts it: one target question per instance of 'target' (CR 601.2c), the first over my Wolf and Cub, the second over the opponent's Vampire and Imp. The 3/3 Wolf deals 3 to the 3/3 Vampire, which dies; the damage is one-sided, so the Wolf is not dealt any. Until 2026-11-06 the menu hid the card, so it was dead in M20 games.
